BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Taylor, Bergquist, Ramel, and Gregerson
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing for tenant screening in common interest communities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tenant screening in common interest communities; adding a new section to chapter 64.32 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 64.34 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 64.38 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 64.90 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 64.32 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) An association of apartment owners may require any apartment owner intending to lease the owner's apartment to use a tenant screening service or obtain background information, including criminal history, on a prospective tenant, at the owner's sole cost and expense, prior to the owner entering into a lease agreement with a prospective tenant.

(2) An association may require proof that the tenant screening requirement has been fulfilled or that the background information on a prospective tenant has been obtained by the owner intending to lease the owner's apartment.
(3) An association may not require that a copy of the tenant screening report or any background information pertaining to a tenant be furnished to the association.

(2) An association may require proof that the tenant screening requirement has been fulfilled or that the background information on a prospective tenant has been obtained by the owner intending to lease the owner's unit.
(3) An association may not require that a copy of the tenant screening report or any background information pertaining to a tenant be furnished to the association.
